responsibility: Implements AVR-specific GCC driver spec functions that rewrite and validate command-line options before invoking subtools. It validates `-mmcu` values, selects and suppresses device-specific specs files and device libraries when appropriate, recognizes architecture names versus concrete devices, and normalizes the coupled `-mdouble=` and `-mlong-double=` options, so this file governs driver-time option synthesis rather than compiler proper code generation.
